build_auto_video_processor: build a video processor from a pretrained model name using AutoVideoProcessor.from_pretrained
create_video_processor_mapping: create a lazy video processor mapping that links config types to their processor classes
register_video_processor: register a custom video processor class for a given model config class
get_video_processor_config: get the video processor configuration dict from a pretrained model path or name
resolve_video_processor_class: resolve a video processor class by its fully qualified name string
